sections.text:
-Target: all enemies. Ability Power 160. Success value 100. 3x physical damage (Fire).
Ability Power boosted by 10 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Success value 100. Applies psychological contamination for 60 seconds.
-Target: all allies. Recovers 20 Cost.
-Target: yourself. Applies beast (increases ATK and MATK by 60%; removes debuffs; removes status ailments; and applies a ward) for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 9000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 9000
[Additional Unison Effect] Applies Kijin on your character for 50 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Applies Beast (increases ATK and MATK by 60%, removes debuffs, removes status ailments, and casts a ward) to all allies for 60 seconds.
[Unison Effect Boost] Increases the Ability Power of the 160-Ability-Power attack that deals physical fire damage to all enemies 3 times with a success value of 100 by 100.
Only [Ignis Raja x Unit-02] Asuka can be used as Unlocking Potential material
